as_told.title: Gary Nolan's lab: debris that might act as waveguides

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that Garry Nolan, a scientist at Stanford, has pieces said to come from crashed unknown craft, given to him by his friend Jacques Vallée, whom Michels calls the godfather of UFO research. Michels says he has seen the parts himself in Nolan's lab, and that Nolan suggested the materials might one day be used as tiny channels for guiding energy here on Earth.
